title: Accelerating Spark queries with Iceberg materialized views
summary: Speeds Spark queries whose SQL can't change by swapping matching plan subtrees for fresh Iceberg materialized views.

title: Under the hood: how Amazon EKS Auto Mode detects, repairs, and diagnoses node failures
summary: Ends manual repair of nodes with dead GPUs or wedged runtimes via agent-set node conditions that Karpenter acts on.

title: Under the hood: Amazon EKS ultra scale clusters
summary: Lifts etcd's write ceiling for huge AI clusters by moving raft consensus to AWS's journal and BoltDB onto tmpfs.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service Under the Hood: OpenSearch Optimized Instances (OR1)
summary: Stops replicas from costing indexing throughput by indexing only on the primary and copying segments through S3.

title: How Prime Video updates its app for more than 8,000 device types
summary: Eases the trade-off between fast C++ and easy-to-ship JavaScript by porting downloaded render code to Rust on Wasm.

title: Amazon Aurora under the hood: indexing geospatial data using Z-order curves
summary: Replaces R-trees, which degrade with insertion order under OLTP, with a B-tree over bit-interleaved z-order keys.

title: Amazon Aurora Under the Hood: Quorum Membership
summary: Avoids Paxos stalls when replacing a suspect segment by requiring both old and new quorums under a new epoch.

title: Amazon Aurora Under the Hood: Reducing Costs Using Quorum Sets
summary: Cuts the cost of storing every copy in full by mixing full and log-only tail segments under Boolean quorum rules.

title: Amazon Aurora Under the Hood: Quorum Reads and Mutating State
summary: Avoids slow quorum reads by reading from one storage node that write acks show is complete up to the read LSN.

title: Amazon Aurora under the hood: quorums and correlated failure
summary: Survives an AZ outage plus another failure by spreading copies across AZs and sizing write and read quorums to match.
